items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: No, Freddie told us that he didn't want to come to the band.

ctx.x: That's interesting. I'm just looking in here at the Sudalter book, the one that you haven't seen yet, about this incident. And they do mention Rollison here. Fred Rollison, Kurt Hitch's Cornet Man. Yeah. I hope he was on the end. Right. The Wolverines had, it says here, the Wolverines had a book of head arrangements, numbering over 85 standards, and about 25 pop tunes, and they didn't have time for me to learn them all.

This is Rollison speaking. Do you remember the Wolverines? No, Freddie told us that he didn't want to come to the band. As far as that goes, we didn't have sheet music. Everything came up from up here. It wasn't written down.
Is a head arrangement that? Yeah, head arrangement. I suppose that's what it means. Yeah. The 85 standards. Yeah. And then it says here that...
